title: Dedupe contacts
skill: Spell out what counts as the same

good: Two changes. 1) contacts/emails.py normalize_email: strip and lowercase; if the domain is gmail.com or googlemail.com, cut the local part at the first '+', remove all dots from it, and use domain gmail.com; other domains only strip+lowercase (keep dots and +tags). 2) contacts/dedupe.py dedupe(contacts): group by normalized email, output in order of first appearance, never mutate the input. Merged contact = {name: first non-empty name, email: normalized email, phones: all phones in order first seen, skipping a phone whose digits-only form (re.sub(r'\D','',p)) was already seen}. A contact whose email is empty after strip is never merged: append a copy as is. Do not change other files. Then run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
lazy: dedupe() misses duplicates. Make it merge contacts that are the same person.
